## Discovery & Translational Science

* **PDE2A inhibition suppresses tuft cell inflammatory response in CRSwNP** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.21.760783)
  * In primary human nasal epithelial cultures and mouse nasal tuft cells, GPCR activation (T2R, SUCNR1, A1 adenosine) lowered cAMP and increased Ca²⁺.
  * PDE2A-selective inhibitors (PF-05180999 and BAY 60-7550) elevated cAMP and attenuated agonist-induced Ca²⁺ signaling, defensin release, and IL-25 secretion without affecting ciliary beat frequency.

* **Synchronization modulation electric field (SMEF) mitigates ischemic acute kidney injury** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.20.760575)
  * In a porcine model of bilateral renal pedicle occlusion (90 min ischemia, 4 h reperfusion), intra-ischemic application of SMEF significantly lowered serum creatinine (1.85 vs 2.33 mg/dL, p = 0.014), BUN, and plasma NGAL.
  * SMEF reduced tubular injury scores (1.31 vs 3.00) and suppressed NF-κB, AP-1, STAT3, ATF4, and HSF1 transcriptional programs, alongside reductions in tissue CCL2 protein (-24%).

* **Telomere maintenance acquired during liposarcoma dedifferentiation** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.28.26364135)
  * Analysis of 11,792 sarcoma NGS profiles in AACR Project GENIE showed telomerase activation (8.8%) and ATRX/DAXX inactivation (8.0%) are mutually exclusive across subtypes.
  * In MDM2-amplified dedifferentiated liposarcoma (DDLPS), telomerase was activated via focal TERT amplification (17.2%) or rearrangement (2.7%). Telomere maintenance alterations occurred in 28.0% of DDLPS vs 8.7% of well-differentiated liposarcoma and predicted shorter overall survival (HR 2.04, p = 0.005).

* **Conserved islet transcriptomic panel identified in type 2 diabetes** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.08.26355184)
  * Cross-fitting meta-analysis across four human islet transcriptomic datasets identified a reproducible beta-cell stress/identity-loss panel.
  * Machine learning and single-cell validation highlighted consensus targets, including GABRA2 and ENSG00000284653, tracking with progressive beta-cell dysfunction.

* **Globus pallidus local field potentials correlate with pediatric dystonia severity** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.03.26364638)
  * Bilateral GPi local field potential recordings using Medtronic Percept RC neurostimulators in 30 pediatric patients showed delta and low-gamma peak power directly predicted BFMDRS-Movement severity scores independent of etiology.

* **Preclinical screening identifies small-molecule Ebola virus inhibitors** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42927861/)
  * A high-throughput assay utilizing a biologically contained virus system identified novel small-molecule inhibitors of Ebola virus replication.

* **Biodegradable zinc stent evaluated in pediatric cardiovascular model** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42928495/)
  * Long-term animal testing of the CardiaZn pediatric biodegradable stent demonstrated structural integrity and favorable tissue compatibility.

* **Arhgef1 deletion causes cortical neurogenesis defects via PAK1 overactivation** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42928451/)
  * Loss of Arhgef1 disrupted early cortical neurogenesis in mouse models through hyperactivation of PAK1, resulting in permanent adult motor dysfunction.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Big Pharma]** **Neoadjuvant durvalumab plus chemotherapy shows feasibility in NSCLC (MDT-BRIDGE)** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04742-7)
  * Phase 2 MDT-BRIDGE trial evaluated neoadjuvant durvalumab with chemotherapy in resectable and borderline resectable non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
  * Multidisciplinary reassessment permitted surgical resection in the majority of patients, yielding high pathological complete response (pCR) rates; unresectable patients safely transitioned to chemoradiotherapy plus consolidative durvalumab.

* **[Biotech]** **Corcept Therapeutics reports Phase 2 BELLA trial data in ovarian cancer** [@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2114688863465591276)
  * Phase 2 trial of cortisol receptor antagonist Lifyorli combined with nab-paclitaxel and bevacizumab demonstrated positive efficacy in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.

* **[Biotech]** **Equillium doses first subject in Phase 1 EQ504 trial** [@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2114697193093489041)
  * First subject dosed in the Phase 1 study of EQ504, triggering a $20M milestone closing and concurrent private placement ($0.57/share). Topline results are anticipated in Q2 2027.

* **[Biotech]** **Orka reports Week 16 data for ORKA-001 in EVERLAST-B trial** [@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2114389076615033110)
  * Interim Week 16 safety and clinical activity data were presented for ORKA-001 from the ongoing EVERLAST-B trial.

* **Divarasib evaluated against sotorasib and adagrasib in KRAS G12C NSCLC** [NEJM](https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2605703?af=R&rss=currentIssue)
  * Published clinical data compared the efficacy and safety profile of the KRAS G12C inhibitor divarasib against first-generation inhibitors sotorasib and adagrasib in advanced NSCLC.

* **Sacituzumab tirumotecan plus pembrolizumab active in PD-L1-negative NSCLC** [NEJM](https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2611280?af=R&rss=currentIssue)
  * Early clinical data demonstrated combination activity with TROP2-directed ADC sacituzumab tirumotecan and pembrolizumab in advanced PD-L1-negative NSCLC.

* **ESMO presentations highlight CDH17 ADC pharmacokinetics** [@JacobPlieth](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2114685215310520405)
  * Comparative PK profiles presented at ESMO 2026 evaluated CDH17-targeted antibody-drug conjugates Multitude AMT-676 versus Avistone/AvanDirect MRG007.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Biotech]** **Summit Therapeutics presents HARMONi-GI1 Phase 3 overall survival data** [@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2114388557804470335), [@JacobPlieth](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2114388956540494050)
  * In the Phase 3 HARMONi-GI1 trial in advanced biliary tract cancer, PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody ivonescimab plus chemotherapy reduced risk of death by 25% versus durvalumab plus chemotherapy (OS HR 0.75).
  * Meeting analysts highlighted similar OS trends seen historically with PD-(L)1 + VEGF combinations (e.g., Imbrave-151).

* **[Biotech]** **BioNTech Phase 3 Dynasty-Breast02 trial yields modest efficacy with safety burden** [@JacobPlieth](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2114653578660810972)
  * BioNTech reported statistically significant but modest efficacy for its HER2-targeted program in metastatic breast cancer.
  * The regimen was associated with a higher incidence of interstitial lung disease (ILD) and fatal adverse events in a small subgroup of patients.

* **[Biotech]** **Mirum Pharmaceuticals reports positive pivotal PROGRESS trial results** [@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2114689068651172118)
  * Cohort 2 of the pivotal PROGRESS study evaluating atebrioz in pediatric patients aged 6 to <12 years with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP) met its primary endpoints.

* **[Biotech]** **Tislelizumab Phase 3 RATIONALE-305 trial reports PRO outcomes** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42927580/)
  * In advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma with PD-L1 TAP score ≥ 5%, patient-reported outcomes correlated significantly with progression-free and overall survival benefits from tislelizumab.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Osimertinib plus savolitinib demonstrates activity post-EGFR TKI progression** [NEJM](https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2611335?af=R&rss=currentIssue)
  * Combination of osimertinib and MET inhibitor savolitinib reported Phase 3 efficacy in patients with MET-amplified advanced NSCLC who progressed on prior EGFR-TKI therapy.

* **Dalmelitinib plus aumolertinib successful in MET-amplified EGFR-TKI resistant NSCLC** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42928710/)
  * A randomized Phase 3 trial confirmed efficacy for MET inhibitor dalmelitinib combined with third-generation EGFR inhibitor aumolertinib in advanced NSCLC presenting with MET amplification and EGFR-TKI resistance.

* **[Big Pharma]** **LEADER trial transportability analysis confirms liraglutide real-world efficacy** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.05.12.25327466)
  * Transporting effect estimates from the Phase 3 LEADER trial into a real-world Veterans Affairs cohort demonstrated a 3-year MACE risk difference of 4.6% (vs 1.6% in trial) and an all-cause mortality risk difference of 2.9% (vs 0.9% in trial).

* **[Big Pharma]** **Radium-223 RAPIT trial real-world analysis completed** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42928397/)
  * Final real-world effectiveness and safety analysis of radium-223 in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) confirmed maintained survival outcomes in clinical practice.

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **FDA CDER ARC Program releases 2026 Annual Report** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-alerts-and-statements/center-drug-evaluation-and-researchs-arc-program-releases-2026-annual-report)
  * The Accelerating Rare disease Cures (ARC) Program released its annual performance report, noting that in 2025, half of CDER novel drug approvals were targeted at rare diseases.
  * Highlighted ongoing regulatory efforts, including expanding the LEADER 3D initiative for trial design guidance and novel statistical methodologies for sparse-patient datasets.

## Business & Strategy

* **[Biotech]** **Moderna updates corporate strategy following mRNA cancer vaccine readout** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/26/moderna-ceo-stephane-bancel-interview-cancer-vaccine-intismeran/?utm_campaign=rss), [@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2114662201130930360)
  * Moderna CEO Stéphane Bancel detailed pipeline reprioritization and commercialization scaling following data from individualized neoantigen therapy intismeran.
  * Piper Sandler raised its price target on Moderna (MRNA) to $230 from $167 following the updates.

* **[Big Pharma]** **AstraZeneca showcases oncology pipeline at ESMO 2026** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/25/esmo-astrazeneca-adcs-lung-gastric-cancer/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * AstraZeneca presented updates across its oncology portfolio, focusing on antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) and combination regimens in gastric and lung cancers.

## Public Health & Policy

* **NIH opens Vaccinology and Immunology Center** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/26/nih-vaccine-injury-center-probes-post-infection-illness/?utm_campaign=rss), [Science Based Medicine](https://sciencebasedmedicine.org/rfk-jr-is-definitely-coming-for-your-vaccines-part-13-the-nih-vaccinology-and-immunology-center/)
  * The NIH Clinical Center launched a dedicated center examining post-infection chronic illnesses and long-term biological effects alongside adverse event safety signals.
  * Concurrently, CMS is evaluating proposed ICD-10 coding frameworks for reporting suspected adverse reactions to national registries.

* **AHA and ACC issue 4-stage cardiovascular health framework for women** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/26/heart-health-women-four-life-stages-qa-sadiya-khan/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * New guidance stratifies female cardiovascular risk across four life stages (adolescence, reproductive years, midlife transition, and older age) to improve clinical risk prediction and intervention.

- Biology & Health
    - [A Red Molecule found in Multiple Foods is Implicated in Brain Health - New Studies](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=blkzcjbPcq4) -- Physionic
        - Clinical trials demonstrate that dietary intake of lycopene and carotenoid-rich foods (such as tomatoes, watermelon juice, and fortified congee) improves cognitive performance, executive function, and functional brain network modulation.
        - Carotenoid supplementation directly influences neurobiological markers, including serum α-synuclein concentrations, monoaminergic function, and gut-brain axis parameters.
        - Epidemiological and prospective cohort data indicate that higher long-term intake of dietary carotenoids, lutein, zeaxanthin, and green leafy vegetables is associated with reduced risk of Alzheimer's dementia, lower Alzheimer's neuropathology, and decreased cognitive decline in older adults.
    - [413 ‒ The neuroscience of emotion: challenging conventional theories of emotion and much more](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0oNeFRTpvUE) -- Peter Attia MD
        - Dr. Lisa Feldman Barrett presents the theory of constructed emotion, challenging traditional models by asserting that emotions lack universal biological signatures, hardwired neural circuits, or discrete biomarkers.
        - The brain operates as a predictive organ rather than a purely reactive one, continuously using past experiences and memory to anticipate sensory inputs, formulate actions, and shape subjective emotional states.
        - Through allostasis, the brain continuously anticipates and manages internal metabolic demands, a system that can be altered by chronic stress, early childhood adversity, and social interactions.
        - Behavioral strategies like generating new predictive models, actively seeking experiences of awe, or managing grief can reframe neural predictions and modulate the body's metabolic budget.
    - [Why Peter changed his mind on Zone 2 training](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/igeLOCTR1MM) -- Peter Attia MD
        - Details how Peter Attia's prescription of Zone 2 aerobic training has evolved, focusing on how an individual's available training time alters the ideal distribution between Zone 2 and higher-intensity exercise.
        - Examines updated positions on longevity nutrition and metabolic therapies, including contextual applications for ketogenic diets, refined protocols for extended fasting, and guardrails for GLP-1 receptor agonist use.
        - Re-evaluates pharmaceutical longevity interventions and diagnostic technologies, noting unresolved dosing questions around rapamycin and current clinical limitations of liquid biopsies.
        - Analyzes exercise selection for strength training, assessing how the risk-reward tradeoff of heavy compound lifts like squats and deadlifts shifts based on individual patient goals.
    - [How Peter’s views have changed over the last 8 years](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/o0CMaP3t-qM) -- Peter Attia MD
        - Outlines an eight-year evolution in clinical perspectives regarding longevity interventions, including ketogenic diets, prolonged fasting protocols, rapamycin administration, and liquid biopsy screening.
        - Discusses necessary guardrails and clinical management strategies for prescribing GLP-1 receptor agonists in weight loss and metabolic care.
        - Explains adjustments to exercise programming, specifically modifying Zone 2 cardio prescriptions based on time availability and re-evaluating squats and deadlifts based on individual risk-reward dynamics.
